title: Air Force hunts for Scientist X
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Air Force hunts for Scientist X, about March 1950 at Denver, Colorado, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Two hours after the lecture ended, Air Force investigators had shown up and were questioning students for clues about Scientist X's identity.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels tells of a lecture given in Denver, Colorado, in March 1950 about crashed flying saucers, which leaned on an unnamed source called Scientist X. He says that two hours after the lecture ended, Air Force investigators showed up and questioned students for clues about who Scientist X was. If true, it would mean the Air Force took the lecture's claims seriously enough to hunt for its secret source.
